fuente: General first-aid steps, not a NASA protocol. The flight surgeon on Earth confirms what to do next.
pasos: Call for help: alert the rest of the crew.
Do not leave the affected person alone.
Check whether they respond and are breathing, and tell the crew.
Keep their blood type and allergies in view (shown on this screen).
Wait for the AI doctor's personalized card and prepare the message to Earth.
que_no_hacer: Do not give any medication without checking their allergies first.
